title: Extensions, Sneaker Deals, and Preseason Buzz: This Week Off the Court
author: Max
summary: A Raptors extension, a Cavaliers sneaker deal, and the rest of what ESPN's preseason buzz tracker picked up this week — a quick business-of-basketball rundown.

content.value:
## Shead Locks In North of the Border

Jamal Shead and the Raptors agreed to a three-year, $24 million extension running through the 2029-30 season, Shams Charania reported. It's a modest number for a starting-caliber point guard — a sign Toronto wanted certainty at the position more than it wanted leverage in the negotiation.

## Mitchell Re-Ups With Adidas

Separately, Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell signed a new multiyear deal with Adidas, extending a partnership that's now outlasted three different coaching staffs in Cleveland.

## What Else ESPN Is Tracking

ESPN's running preseason buzz file has more where that came from — extensions, signings, and trade intel updating through the start of the regular season. Expect more line items like these before opening night.
